fichas.title: Windows: Thermal Insulation
fichas.summary: Overview of window forms by casement and frame type, window placement in walls, insulation and sun-protection arrangements, thermal-transmittance limits, and joint-permeability classes. The text discusses thermal and sound insulation, natural ventilation, dimensional tolerances, and airtightness requirements.
uses: Admit daylight while limiting heat transfer
Provide natural ventilation, including in strong wind and rain when an external impact pane is used
Meet airtightness and minimum air-change requirements
